{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (999999.99)
qa_orders = (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)
sales_clean = sales[~qa_orders].copy()

# Drop refunded orders
refunded = sales_clean['status'] == 'refunded'
sales_final = sales_clean[~refunded].copy()

# Now, compute mean age of customers who converted
# Exclude those with age = -1 (missing data)
converted_customers = sales_final[sales_final['converted'] == 1]
valid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute and print the number of valid converted customers with non-missing age
num_valid_converted = len(valid_ages)
print(num_valid_converted)

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()
print(mean_age)

# Round to two decimals for final answer
mean_age_rounded = round(mean_age, 2)
print(mean_age_rounded)"}
